The *Māgaṇḍiyasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 9) is the ninth chapter of the *Mahāniddesa*, an early canonical commentary preserved within the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Translated as the *Exposition of the Discourse to Māgaṇḍiya*, the text provides an extensive, verse-by-verse doctrinal and lexical exegesis of the *Māgaṇḍiya Sutta* (Snp 4.9) from the *Aṭṭhakavagga* of the *Sutta Nipāta* [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].

SuttaCentral notes a curated passage-level parallel to the text in the *Mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 8) of the *Cullaniddesa*, and records its thematic and textual connections with several early discourses and treatises, including the *Samiddhisutta* (SN 1.20), *Hāliddikānisutta* (SN 22.3), *Bhaddekaratta Sutta* (MN 131), *Sabhiya Sutta* (Snp 3.6), the Sanskrit *Śarīrārthagāthā*, and multiple other chapters of both the *Mahāniddesa* (Mnd 4, Mnd 10) and *Cullaniddesa* (Cnd 23) [SuttaCentral].

Computational analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive Pali-internal text reuse, amounting to 5,376 matches across 191 Pali works [DharmaNexus]. Aside from sharing verses directly with its root text (Snp 4.9) and the commentary *Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā*, the text shares extensive passages with other Niddesa chapters, most notably the *Mahābyūhasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 13), *Nandamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 11), *Attadaṇḍasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 15), *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23), *Suddhaṭṭhakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 4), *Purābhedasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 10), and *Mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 8, corroborating SuttaCentral's identification) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Substantial shared material is also found in canonical collections such as the *Khandha Saṁyutta* (SN 22) and the *Dasakanipāta* (AN 10) [DharmaNexus].
